description: Get one provider or media profile by exact slug from search_suppliers or search. Returns sourced facts with stable ids and evidence status, approved buyer answers and overview where published, sources, assessment and missing product information. Unknown or unpublished slugs return a not-found error. Missing means unknown; egg_score measures evidence readiness, not product quality. Research prompts are withheld.

slug.description: Exact provider or media profile slug returned by search_suppliers or search; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.

name: get_supplier
